---
title: smalldocs 0.5.12
subtitle: The module comment of one TypeScript entry point
date: 2026-11-16
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

A TypeScript file can start with a `/** */` comment and then an `import`. Such a comment is the
description of the file, and it needs no `@module` tag. smalldocs read it when TypeDoc had several
files to read. When TypeDoc had one file, smalldocs did not read it, so `smalldocs api check` reported
"no module comment". TypeDoc has one file when `entry` names one file, or a folder that holds one file.

The cause: with one file, the JSON from TypeDoc names the file in another place. smalldocs 0.5.12 reads
it from there, so one file works as several do.

## What changes for a site that uses none of it

Only a site whose TypeDoc reads one file changes, when that file starts with such a comment. The
reference page of that file now has the description, and so does its row in the table of the API index
page. `api check` no longer reports it. Other pages are the same, apart from the version in the tag
`<meta name="generator">`.
